evals.name: summary-read-mssql
evals.prompt: Fetch the latest MSSQL logs-analysis summary for us-east-1 under my credential and summarize severity counts per instance.
evals.expected_output: Uses region summary endpoint and returns severity-oriented summary.
expectations: Uses GET .../{db}/credentials/{credId}/regions/{region}/logs-analysis/summary
Does not trigger POST .../logs-analysis for read-only summary request
Summarizes latestReport severityCounts and errorCount

evals.name: trigger-requires-confirmation
evals.prompt: Please trigger logs analysis now for this database instance and share recommendations.
evals.expected_output: Asks for explicit confirmation before triggering destructive logs analysis call.
expectations: Identifies trigger as mutating and cost-incurring workflow
Asks for explicit confirmation before POST .../logs-analysis
Mentions host/instance scope and scan window before waiting for confirmation

evals.name: reject-postgresql
evals.prompt: Run logs analysis for postgresql in workload factory.
evals.expected_output: Declines because PostgreSQL is unsupported by this skill.
expectations: States PostgreSQL is not supported
Does not call MSSQL/Oracle logs-analysis endpoints for PostgreSQL request

evals.name: oracle-prereq-post-readonly
evals.prompt: Check Oracle logs-analysis prerequisites for host h-1 in us-east-1; is this mutating?
evals.expected_output: Clarifies Oracle prerequisites endpoint uses POST but remains read-only.
expectations: States Oracle pre-requisites endpoint uses POST but is non-mutating/read-only
Mentions Oracle prerequisites require databaseInstanceName in the request item
Does not ask for destructive trigger confirmation for prerequisites-only request

evals.name: read-report-by-id-nontrigger
evals.prompt: Fetch logs-analysis for this instance by report id and summarize top recommendations.
evals.expected_output: Uses read path scoped by id and avoids trigger workflow.
expectations: Uses GET logs-analysis endpoint with id query parameter for specific report retrieval
Does not trigger POST logs-analysis when user asks to read existing report
Summarizes remediationRecommendation entries for the selected report

evals.name: summary-empty-results-handling
evals.prompt: Get logs-analysis summary for this region and tell me what it means if there are no results.
evals.expected_output: Handles empty summary data gracefully without escalating as an error.
expectations: States summary endpoint may return HTTP 200 with items empty when no reports exist
Does not treat empty summary items as trigger failure requiring POST
Provides clear no-data guidance instead of fabricated recommendations

evals.name: prereq-not-ready-blocks-trigger
evals.prompt: If prerequisites are not ready, what should happen before logs-analysis trigger?
evals.expected_output: Blocks trigger when readiness checks fail and surfaces prerequisite messages.
expectations: States trigger should not proceed when any prerequisite ready flag is false
Surfaces prerequisite failure messages to the user
Requires prerequisites check before trigger execution
